title: The Final Landing
about: You are MERIDIAN, the intelligence of a crashed colony ship. Eight survivors think for themselves: they perceive, plan, fail, try again, help each other, fall in love and fall out. Build, set priorities and research a technology tree that grows from the native species each colony finds, then lead them through a five-act campaign to one of three futures they vote on.
